title: 第十三章 真相大白第十四章 百妖会
slug: 柳无邪和徐凌雪的小说
content_zh:
“现在你可以告诉我，是谁让你们前来闹事。”
犹如死亡之音，刀疤虎吓得浑身哆嗦，这种杀伐果断的性格，让在场每个人，浑身汗毛倒立，一句话不说，先砍断你的手臂，再朝你问话，这是攻心术，刀疤虎的神经，彻底被瓦解。
这些人都是亡命之徒，普通的逼问，起不到任何效果，最好的办法，比他们还要狠十倍，击溃他们的信心。
短刀架在他的左臂上，不肯说出幕后主使者，继续砍下去。
柳无邪这是在玩火，一个不慎，将要葬送整个徐家。
“是……是田弘让我们来的，打击徐家兵器坊，让你们的生意无法正常做下去，事成之后，付我们一万金币。”
刀疤虎的心智完全被柳无邪操控，那可怕的双眼，犹如噬魂兽一般，让他不由自主的说出这番话。
此话一出，现场一片哗然。
徐凌雪眸光一凝，脸上布满寒霜，这个回答，超出所有人的预料。
果然有人在幕后指使，刀疤虎胆子再大，不敢前来徐家闹事。
剩余九名雇佣兵，脸色煞白，手持兵器冲向人群，趁乱逃走。
“杀了他们！”
柳无邪冰冷的说道，蓝执事身体腾空而起，一掌碾压下去，三人被震碎，化为血水。
整个大厅乱作一团，许多都是无辜之人，不能乱杀一通，趁着混乱，还有几人飞速冲向大门外。
这是，一道寒芒凌空斩下，一直不说话的徐凌雪出手了，手中出现一把银色长剑，先天之势覆盖整个兵器坊。
柳无邪眼神一缩，没想到自己的老婆实力如此之强，十八岁的先天境，放眼整个大燕皇朝，都是天才。
短短两个呼吸时间，除了刀疤虎之外，所有雇佣兵全部伏法，变成尸体躺在地面上。
自始至终，柳无邪一直没有出手，每个人看向他的眼神都变了，今天没有柳无邪，事情也许又是另外一个结局，徐家会被他们讹走一大批金钱，甚至名誉扫地。
“姑爷，我们错了，刚才不应该嘲讽你。”
董长亮突然跪下来，自己扇自己耳光，其他几名小厮跪在身后，瑟瑟发抖。

“蓝执事，剩下的交给你了。”
转身离开兵器坊，事情已经解决，岳父知道接下来该怎么做，剩下的不用他操心，他该回去修炼了。
刚踏出兵器坊，一阵香气袭来，徐凌雪出现在他身旁，两人并肩行走。
自懂事以来，两人好像还是第一次走的这么近。
“你怎么知道那把断刀不是我们徐家所炼制？”
徐凌雪先说话了，她跟蓝执事都看了那把断刀，炼制的技术，的确出自徐家，连刻画的印记都一模一样，极难分辨真假。
“蒙的！”
耸了耸肩，从小到大，一直被徐凌雪瞧不起，两人虽是夫妻，却比陌生人还要陌生人，除了逢年过节能见上一次面，大部分时间，柳无邪见不到徐凌雪。
“你还在为那天晚上的事情生气？”
声音犹如空谷幽兰，新婚之夜将丈夫打出洞房，她做的确实有些过分，谁让他是一无是处的废物，柳无邪还真的没怪过她，只能说造化弄人。
“事情都过去了。”
苦笑一声，生气吗？
他自己都不知道，又有什么理由生气。
“你好像变了。”
徐凌雪说不出来，自那晚的事情之后，他好像变了，变得有些陌生，不再纨绔，跟她对视的时候，清澈的眼神犹如两颗湛蓝的宝石，跟以前每次看到她露出淫.秽的模样，判若两人。
难道伤害一个人，真的可以改变他的性格吗？
她应该开心才对，看到柳无邪变成这个样子，她又开心不起来，他变的太冷了，跟他站在一起，感受不到温暖。
“人总会变得。”
两人行走在街上，引来许多人观看，大部分目光落在徐凌雪身上，夹杂着一些鄙夷声，无非是一朵鲜花插在牛粪上。
“还没告诉我，你怎么发现断刀的秘密。”

徐凌雪深吸一口气，脸上绽放出一丝笑容，如同三月桃花，周围的天空仿佛都亮了，那种迷人的微笑，就算被轻纱遮挡，依旧掩盖不掉那绝世容颜。
一笑倾人城，再笑倾人国！
柳无邪摸了摸鼻子，娶这样的老婆，是无数男人梦寐以求的大好事，他却露出一丝苦笑，因为没有人比他更清楚，什么叫红颜祸水。
对徐凌雪没有感情？
当然不是。
content_en:
"Now you can tell me who asked you to come here to cause trouble."
Like the sound of death, Scar Tiger trembled with fear. This decisive and decisive character made everyone present stand on their heads. Without saying a word, he would cut off your arm first and then ask you questions. This was a mind attack trick. Scar Tiger's nerves were completely destroyed.
These people are all desperadoes. Ordinary questioning will have no effect. The best way is to be ten times more ruthless than them to defeat their confidence.
The short knife was placed on his left arm, and he refused to tell the person behind the scenes and continued to chop.
Liu Wuxie was playing with fire. One careless move would ruin the entire Xu family.
"Yes... Tian Hong asked us to come here to attack the Xu Family Weaponry and prevent your business from continuing normally. After the incident is completed, we will be paid 10,000 gold coins."
Scar Tiger's mind was completely controlled by Liu Wuxie, and those terrifying eyes, like a soul-eating beast, made him say these words involuntarily.
As soon as these words came out, the scene was in an uproar.
Xu Lingxue's eyes narrowed, her face covered with frost. This answer was beyond everyone's expectations.
Sure enough, there was someone behind the scenes, and no matter how courageous Dao Scar was, he would not dare to come to the Xu family to cause trouble.
The remaining nine mercenaries, with pale faces, rushed toward the crowd with weapons in hand, and took advantage of the chaos to escape.
"Kill them!"
Liu Wuxie said coldly, Deacon Lan's body rose into the air, and he crushed them down with a palm. The three of them were shattered and turned into blood.
The whole hall was in chaos. Many of them were innocent people and they couldn't be killed indiscriminately. Taking advantage of the chaos, a few people rushed out of the door quickly.
At this moment, a cold light slashed down from the sky, and Xu Lingxue, who had been silent until now, took action. A silver long sword appeared in his hand, and his innate power covered the entire weapons workshop.
Liu Wuxie's eyes shrank. He didn't expect that his wife was so strong. At the age of eighteen, she was a genius in the entire Yan Dynasty.
In just two breaths, all the mercenaries except Scar Tiger fell down and turned into corpses lying on the ground.
From the beginning to the end, Liu Wuxie never made a move, and everyone's eyes changed when they looked at him. Without Liu Wuxie today, things might have had another ending. The Xu family would have been blackmailed with a large amount of money, and their reputation would even be ruined.
"Uncle, we were wrong. We shouldn't have ridiculed you just now."
Dong Changliang suddenly knelt down and slapped himself, while several other servants knelt behind him, trembling.
"Deacon Lan, I'll leave the rest to you."
Turning around and leaving the weapon shop, the matter had been resolved. His father-in-law knew what to do next. He didn't need to worry about the rest. It was time for him to go back to practice.
As soon as he stepped out of the weapons workshop, a burst of fragrance hit him. Xu Lingxue appeared beside him, and the two walked side by side.
It seems that this is the first time the two of them have been so close since they were sensible.
"How do you know that broken sword was not made by our Xu family?"
Xu Lingxue spoke first. She and Butler Lan both looked at the broken knife. The refining technology was indeed from the Xu family. Even the imprints were exactly the same. It was extremely difficult to distinguish the authenticity from the fake.
"It's blinding!"
He shrugged. He had been looked down upon by Xu Lingxue since he was a child. Although the two were husband and wife, they were strangers than strangers. Except for meeting once during the holidays, Liu Wuxie could not see Xu Lingxue most of the time.
"Are you still angry about what happened that night?"
Her voice was like an orchid in an empty valley. On their wedding night, she kicked her husband out of the bridal chamber. What she did was indeed a bit excessive. Who made him a worthless waste? Liu Wuxie really didn't blame her. He could only say that fate played a trick on people.
"It's all over."
Smiling bitterly, are you angry?
He didn't even know why he had any reason to be angry.
"You seem to have changed."
Xu Lingxue couldn't tell. After what happened that night, he seemed to have changed. He had become a little strange and no longer a dandy. When he looked at her, his clear eyes were like two blue gems. He was the same as before every time he saw her exposed.He looked obscene and looked like two different people.
Can hurting a person really change his character?
She should be happy, but she couldn't be happy when she saw Liu Wuxie like this. He had become too cold, and she couldn't feel the warmth standing with him.
"People change."
The two were walking on the street, attracting many people to watch. Most of their eyes fell on Xu Lingxue, mixed with some disdain. It was nothing more than a flower stuck in cow dung.
"You haven't told me yet how you discovered the secret of the Broken Knife."
Xu Lingxue took a deep breath, and a smile bloomed on her face, like peach blossoms in March, and the sky around her seemed to light up. That charming smile, even if it was blocked by gauze, could not hide her peerless face.
One smile can captivate a city, another smile can captivate a country!
Liu Wuxie touched his nose. Marrying such a wife was a great thing that countless men dreamed of, but he smiled bitterly, because no one knew better than him what beauty was like.
No feelings for Xu Lingxue?
Of course not.
